title: The English Indices of Deprivation 2025: every lower-layer super output area's ranks, scores, deciles and population denominators
provider: The Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government, https://www.gov.uk/government/statistics/english-indices-of-deprivation-2025; File 7 (CSV)
credit: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government, English Indices of Deprivation 2025. Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
format: CSV, one row per LSOA (2021 boundaries) with its local authority district (2024 boundaries): the IMD and its seven domains as scores, ranks and deciles, the supplementary indices, and the population denominators (mid-2022). Read by data/products/allocation_cases.py.
coverage: 33,755 LSOAs in 296 local authority districts. The Index is relative, not a time series, and the release warns that many deprived people live in areas that are not deprived.
licence: Open Government Licence v3.0. Fetched into data/cache/products/allocation/raw/ and never committed.
